trial_info.title: A Phase I/Ib Global, Multicenter, Open-label Umbrella Study Evaluating the Safety and Efficacy of Targeted Therapies in Subpopulations of Patients With Metastatic Colorectal Cancer (INTRINSIC)

patient_to_trial_evaluation.reasoning: The patient meets several inclusion criteria, including age, metastatic colorectal cancer, ECOG performance status, and willingness to undergo molecular profiling. The patient does NOT have active brain metastases or active infection. However, the creatinine clearance is concerning, given the creatinine of 1.8 mg/dL and eGFR of 35 mL/min/1.73m². The trial excludes patients with creatinine clearance < 60 mL/min, and the upper limit of normal (ULN) for bilirubin is needed to evaluate liver function. The patient also has a KRAS G13D mutation, which may or may not be suitable for a targeted therapy being evaluated in this trial, depending on the specific arms available. We need to determine the specific inclusion/exclusion criteria for KRAS G13D mutations in this trial.
